text: [111] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato kulūpako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca katamehi pañcahi asanthavavissāsī ca hoti anissaravikappī ca byatthupasevī 3 ca upakaṇṇakajappī ca atiyācanako ca imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kulūpako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca . pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato kulūpako bhikkhu kulesu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca katamehi pañcahi na asanthavavissāsī ca hoti na anissaravikappī ca na byatthupasevī 3 ca na upakaṇṇakajappī ca na atiyācanako ca imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kulūpako bhikkhu kulesu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cāti .
